items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: When I had Milton Fletcher on trumpet

ctx.x: Well, no, this was one when I rehearsed at the Sunset. That's where I got this band together, at the Sunset. When I had Milton Fletcher on trumpet, and I can't recall the other boy's name, might come to me (inaudible). Again, Milton Fletcher was on trumpet, Prentice McCarey on piano, and -- who did I have on the other tenor? Because I wanted to get Pettiford from Pettifoss Minneapolis, one of the Pettifoss Brothers. A whale of a tenor man.
